==================
block comment with =end in the middle of a line
==================

=begin
this has =end with spaces after it
=end
puts 1

---

(program
  (comment)
  (call
    method: (identifier)
    arguments: (argument_list
      (integer))))

==================
block comment before a method keeps its place
==================

def a
  1
end
=begin
doc with =end in the text
=end
def b
  2
end

---

(program
  (method
    name: (identifier)
    body: (body_statement
      (integer)))
  (comment)
  (method
    name: (identifier)
    body: (body_statement
      (integer))))

foo

  (ERROR
